title: RIO Receipt
description: A cryptographic record of an AI action, written to a tamper-evident ledger. The core receipt proves what happened, when, and which system initiated it. Governance and authorization fields are optional extensions for systems that implement human approval workflows.

receipt_id.description: Unique identifier for this receipt. MUST be a v4 UUID.

receipt_type.description: Receipt classification. 'action' is the base proof-layer type (no governance required). 'governed_action' indicates governance and authorization were applied. Other types are reserved for system events.

intent_id.description: The intent this receipt covers. Links the receipt to the original action request.

action.description: The action type that was performed (e.g., 'send_email', 'create_pr', 'transfer_funds').

agent_id.description: Identifier of the AI agent or system that initiated the action.

authorized_by.description: Optional. Who or what authorized the action (e.g., 'HUMAN:jane@example.com', 'POLICY:auto_approve_low_risk'). Null when no authorization step was involved.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the receipt was generated.

hash_chain.description: Cryptographic hash chain binding the receipt to its source data. Core fields (intent_hash, execution_hash, receipt_hash) are always required. Governance and authorization hashes are present only when those stages were performed.

intent_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonical intent object.

governance_hash.description: Optional. SHA-256 hash of the governance decision. Present only when governance was applied.

authorization_hash.description: Optional. SHA-256 hash of the authorization record. Present only when human or policy approval was required.

execution_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the execution result.

receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the receipt itself, computed from receipt_id + all present stage hashes (in chain_order) + timestamp.

verification.description: Metadata describing how to verify this receipt.

algorithm.description: The hash algorithm used. MUST be SHA-256.

chain_length.description: Number of hashes in the chain. 3 for proof-layer receipts (intent, execution, receipt). 5 for governed receipts (adds governance, authorization).

chain_order.description: Ordered list of hash field names used to compute receipt_hash. For proof-layer: ['intent_hash', 'execution_hash', 'receipt_hash']. For governed: ['intent_hash', 'governance_hash', 'authorization_hash', 'execution_hash', 'receipt_hash'].

ingestion.description: Optional. Provenance metadata recording how the original intent entered the system.

source.description: The channel through which the intent was received.

source_message_id.description: Original message ID from the source system.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the intent was received.

identity_binding.description: Optional. Cryptographic proof binding the receipt to a specific signer identity.

public_key_hex.description: Hex-encoded Ed25519 public key of the signer.

signature_hex.description: Hex-encoded Ed25519 signature of the receipt_hash. 128 hex characters (64 bytes). Present only when ed25519_signed is true.

signature_payload_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the payload that was signed. MUST equal hash_chain.receipt_hash.

ed25519_signed.description: Whether this receipt was signed with Ed25519.
